title: French user sees English: "Invalid password", untranslated sys_user labels in Home feed, misleading Locale help (#27521 row 22)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 22 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every non-English user (measured as a French user). What happens: (a) a wrong temporary password answers English "Invalid password"; (b) the Home feed reads `Updated User "Carl Edited": Banned et Ban Reason` — French glue, English field labels; (c) the Locale help says "Preferred language for this user's notifications", but the setting switches the whole UI. Reach: every non-English user. (The forced-change body and field are fixed in PR #27849.)

## Mechanism

- (a) `plugin-auth` / better-auth: the refusal carries no `code` the console localises, so the server's English text is shown.
- (b) `packages/platform-objects` ships no `fr` bundle for `sys_user`, so field labels in the feed fall back to English.
- (c) `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` `locale` help (en generated bundle line 96 on main: "Preferred language for this user's notifications, …").

Read in the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad`; the source line is confirmed on `main` (not re-driven).

## Wanted

(a) a coded refusal the console can translate; (b) the missing `fr` translations for `sys_user`; (c) a corrected Locale help line that says it sets the UI language.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A wrong temporary password under fr shows a French message, from a code the console maps.
- [ ] The Home feed's sys_user update line reads French field labels under fr.
- [ ] The Locale help says it sets the user's interface language, in every shipped pack.

Refs #27521
